parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS new_briefs,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' AND assigned_to_user_id IS NOT NULL) AS taken_in_work,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'done' AND completed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('active','on_hold','dispute')) AS in_progress_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('active','on_hold','dispute') AND assigned_to_user_id IS NULL) AS unassigned_total
FROM projects;
